producerContract: Real blessed scroll a is read with the maintained star cleanup substring before any movement or polymorph.
Initial live monsters must exist; all original live IDs must leave raw map occupancy. Dead list nodes may remain until dmonsfree.
No live monster of any kind may occur from cleaned boundary to final boundary. This is stronger than no live damaging monsters; !debug_mongen is retained and does not guarantee absence.
Human HP and maximum must stay healthy through setup. Exact chosen polymorph mh equals mhmax and mhmax exceeds the species level before fire.
One relative west move from cleanup position reaches ROOM on the same level with no objects or trap. No terminal coordinates are treated as game coordinates.
Gloves must be slot b, worn with W_ARMG and real Gloves_on timeout; unseen fire trap appears underfoot before #sit or look.
No selected gameplay state is changed by the observer, and all five streams plus pending EOF must agree across observed/plain/deferred.
limits: Native results pending parent. No C recording or runtime candidate.
Random generation remains enabled by !debug_mongen; any live monster during observation is a retained failed setup.
Newly wished trap is unseen, so this does not isolate the seen-trap Fumbling dodge guard.
Underwater, slime, !box, blind and human-floor differences remain open; not asserted fixed.
Complete cleanup chosen owners were read; special quest/shop/guard/Rider/artifact and migrating-level cleanup branches are not claimed exercised.
